text:
jana: Heads up — spotted a small cluster of negative invoice adjustments in Console for several EU tenants after yesterday's route-enrich rollout. preview shows negative token deltas, small numbers but repeated across windows.

omar: I see it too. console preview for t-42 shows -120 tokens in window 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC. looks like session_end events are landing after invoice_window_close and being applied as adjustments.

ben: Could be the old dedupe/ttl mismatch. Edge tags events with dedupe TTL=60s, aggregator's dedupe window is effectively 5s for perf. Out-of-order delivery would cause late negatives.

jana: sample raw events from the ingest logs: 
```
{"tenant":"t-42","event":"session_end","seq":10012,"ts":1709988002,"tokens":-120}
{"tenant":"t-42","event":"invoice_window_close","ts":1709988000}
```

omar: exactly — session_end.ts > window_close.ts but arrival is delayed, aggregator processes it after the window finalized and subtracts from invoice. We need stronger ordering or retrospective reconciliation.

sari: quick mitigation thought: add a UI flag to mark affected preview invoices as "under reconciliation" and suppress pager noise. For the pipeline itself maybe ignore session_end that have ts < (window_close_ts - 30s)? feels hacky.

ben: Longer-term: add ingestion sequence numbers and source_zone metadata so aggregator can do LWW/seq-based dedupe. Short-term: extend dedupe TTL for EU to 2m and run a backfill job to re-evaluate closed windows that received late events.

jana: can we avoid destabilizing the rollout? maybe featureflag route-enrich so we keep event ordering stable while we patch.

omar: proposed rollout plan: 
- ingest API: accept optional `ingest_seq` and `source_zone` headers (backwards-compatible)
- aggregator: prefer ordering by ingest_seq when present, otherwise fall back to event.ts
- extend dedupe window config per-region (EU -> 120s)
- schedule backfill consumer to re-eval windows for last 24h that had negative adjustments

metering-bot: Incident INV-NEGATIVE-2026-03-21 created: 23 tenants affected, peak rate 7/min, top impacted tenants: t-42, t-73. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/runbooks/inv-negative. Pager: on-call if >100 tenants. :rotating_light:

ben: I'll open the PR for the ingest header and docs now. @omar can you take aggregator change? @sari can you add the Console banner and adjust preview alerting so SRE isn't paged for preview-only deltas?

sari: on it — adding "Under reconciliation" banner and a soft-alert channel for preview diffs. won't suppress real invoice alerts.

jana: timeline: want quick mitigation (extend dedupe & UI banner) within 2 hours, full aggregator patch + backfill by EOD. I'll toggle a canary on route-enrich to reduce ordering shuffles.

omar: starting canary patch to keep seq header now, pushing to canary-1 EU shard. will post status in this thread when canary is up.

ben: thx — include a note in CHANGELOG for customers who rely on preview invoices. also run small synthetic to ensure backfill idempotency.

jana: thanks team. keep updates short here.
